title: 3576. Transform Array to All Equal Elements

examples.explanation: We can make all elements in the array equal in 2 operations as follows: Choose index i = 1, and multiply both nums[1] and nums[2] by -1. Now nums = [1,1,-1,-1,1]. Choose index i = 2, and multiply both nums[2] and nums[3] by -1. Now nums = [1,1,1,1,1].
It is not possible to make all array elements equal in at most 5 operations.
